name: financial-ui-suite
description: Financial UI design skills: correctness patterns plus 14 visual styles for trading, portfolio, and market data interfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Patterns and 14 visual styles for financial UIs
interface.longDescription: Two skill layers for building financial products. financial-ui-patterns covers correctness: tabular numbers, semantic tokens, tick flash, streaming state, accessibility, charts, order entry. financial-ui-styles picks one of 14 visual systems, from a Bloomberg-style terminal to Robinhood-style retail.
defaultPrompt: Build a portfolio holdings table with the financial UI patterns skill.
